subject: Step E.5: AP-8 unified-Glicko-surface migration (3 sub-steps)

E.5b: Create migrate_junction_glicko_to_edge_significance.sql — convert entity_pos/pattern_deprel/entity_morph_feature/entity_lexname/entity_language rows to has_pos/has_deprel_pattern/has_morph_feature/has_lexname/has_language edges with edge_significance rows carrying existing mu/sigma/games. activeForm: Migrating junction Glicko to unified edge_significance
